body.name: split-sample estimated Appell score
body.construction: Using the nonempty \(b_n(\alpha/16)\)-block partition in \(\operatorname{MOM}_{\alpha/16}\), for \(j=1,2,3,4\) set \(\widehat m_j=\operatorname{clip}_{[-V_{\mathrm{env}},V_{\mathrm{env}}]}\{\operatorname{MOM}_{\alpha/16}(r_{K,1}^j,\ldots,r_{K,n}^j)\}\); set \(\widehat\mu=\widehat m_1\), \(\widehat v=\widehat m_2-\widehat m_1^2\), \(\widehat c_3=\widehat m_3-3\widehat m_1\widehat m_2+2\widehat m_1^3\), \(\widehat k_4=\widehat m_4-4\widehat m_1\widehat m_3+12\widehat m_1^2\widehat m_2-6\widehat m_1^4-3\widehat m_2^2\), and \(\widehat A_3(u)=(u-\widehat\mu)^3-3\widehat v(u-\widehat\mu)-\widehat c_3\).
